challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Regular initiation and approximately weekly one-on-one time demonstrate sustained interest, weighing meaningfully toward A.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner show personal effort and responsiveness, further supporting A.
Independently resuming contact after geographic separations indicates continuity of interest rather than purely passive convenience.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: The challenge facts establish genuine and sustained interest, so B should not be read as an absence of care. However, B remains somewhat better supported because Casey twice avoided defining the relationship without a timeline (C2-F4), generally favored short-notice or geographically convenient meetings and canceled two advance plans for other commitments (C2-F5), and avoided social integration and longer-range planning (C2-F6). Together, those facts more directly indicate limited commitment despite meaningful involvement.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Drew could ask what level of commitment and future planning Casey is presently willing to offer, while recognizing the demonstrated interest in C2-F1 through C2-F3.
